title: Psychedelic Alchemy Scene
description: A vibrant surreal painting shows a hooded figure with a split blue and red face holding a blue flower, sitting beside a large brown mouse clutching a dripping rainbow lollipop. They are positioned on a stone ledge filled with potion bottles, an open spellbook, and scattered gold pieces, with a green horse galloping above in a swirling colorful sky over desert dunes.
prompt: A highly detailed psychedelic surreal scene featuring a hooded figure with half blue and half red face and dripping black tears, sitting at an alchemist table next to a giant realistic brown mouse holding a large swirling rainbow lollipop. The table has potion bottles, an open ancient book, gold nuggets, and flowers. In the background a vibrant green horse with rainbow mane gallops across a desert dune under a swirling colorful sky with dripping paint effects and poppies, in a vibrant trippy illustrative style with melting colorful drips.
